source_caption_text:
Moneybagg Yo’s catalog deserves a serious conversation 😮‍💨🔥

From “Time Today” and “Wockesha” to “Said Sum,” “Me vs Me” and “All of a Sudden” with Lil Baby, Bagg has plenty of records you know as soon as the beat drops 💯

Then you get into projects like “Federal 3X,” “2 Heartless,” “Time Served” and “A Gangsta’s Pain” and remember how many songs he’s given fans over the years. The singles alone make a strong case, but everybody who follows his music has a few deeper cuts they’ll defend too 🎧🔥

Whether you prefer his earlier mixtapes or the bigger hits, putting his songs together makes you realize how tough choosing a top five actually is.
